message: 小さなハルマゲドン

name: Synn
message: 「Is it over?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't look like it」
Azel stood up as if nothing had happened at all.

name: Ria
message: 「Again...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though we're pushing him back this hard?!」
Amidst the raining meteors, Azel refuses to fall.
No matter how many times they shatter his defenses, a new wall of light immediately regenerates.
Unlike the Demon Generals, the power of God himself never runs dry.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please, let's stop doing this, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「Pitiful wretches who reject the Lord's grace. You are the ones who should cease this futility.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wouldn't call it futile. He's taken plenty of accumulated damage too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then if we keep going like this!」

name: Paqy
message: 「At this rate, we won't beat him before Pre-Materialize Overdrive--or rather, before the spacetime collapse begins.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, doesn't Azel's movement seem a little off to you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」
Bylous's words flashed back into my mind.

name: Bylous
message: 「'Aim for... his left... Nibe and I... wounded the same spot... three... times... There has to be an opening...'」

name: Synn
message: 「Focus your attacks on the left side of Azel's body!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood!」
Our attacks concentrate on the left half of Azel's body!

name: Azel
message: 「What?!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's working!」
The defensive array once thought infinite erodes, melting away like heated candy!
Our attacks outpace the speed at which his defenses regenerate!

name: Azel
message: 「Curse you, Demon Lord! Curse you, Demons! Curse you, Crusaders!」

name: Azel
message: 「Curse you! Die! Die!」
Light goes berserk, centering on Azel.
Lightning rains down upon us, and heat waves rage.
Yet, united as one will, we remain unbroken and shatter everything.

name: Azel
message: 「How could--how, how could this happen!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying the Lord's will is not absolute?! Impossible, absurd!」

name: Azel
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaargh!」
Just as the battle ended, the sun peeked over the horizon and cast its light upon us.
The long, long night is over, and the day of the Holy Night Festival has arrived!
